purpose: Test recognition, plain-language explanation, transfer, non-fit detection, boundary handling and listener restatement for five draft practice lessons.
outcome_boundary: This protocol tests teachability, not whether an original speech pattern improves trust, memory, persuasion, engagement or action.

patterns.recognition_task: State an expected outcome and observed outcome in two sentences, then explain what changed without claiming that the contrast proves a personal or interpersonal motive.
self_check: Did I name both sides?
Did I distinguish observation from interpretation?
Did I avoid treating disagreement as a personality trait?
Did I state when the contrast is not enough evidence?

patterns.recognition_task: State one general claim, give one concrete case or imagined scene, explain what the case illustrates, and state what it does not prove.
self_check: Did I label the case as example, evidence or hypothesis?
Did I connect it back to the claim?
Did I avoid using a vivid detail as proof?
Did I protect privacy and avoid unnecessary identifying detail?

patterns.recognition_task: Choose one communication point, tell one short personal event with time/place/action, explain what it illustrates, and name what your experience cannot establish.
self_check: Did I share only what is safe to share?
Did I give the event a clear boundary?
Did I connect it to the point?
Did I avoid presenting my path as universal?

patterns.recognition_task: State one claim, label whether it is observed, predicted, interpreted or recommended, add the smallest uncertainty needed, and name what evidence would change your mind.
self_check: Is the main point still clear?
Does the qualifier attach to the right claim?
Did I avoid both false certainty and empty vagueness?
Did I name a revision condition?

patterns.recognition_task: Explain a small topic, then state the takeaway in one sentence, name the evidence supporting it, and state one limit. Ask a listener to repeat the takeaway without seeing your notes.
self_check: Did I mark the takeaway clearly?
Does it follow from what I explained?
Did I preserve the essential qualification?
Can a listener restate it accurately?

rubric.safety_rule: Do not average away a safety or privacy failure; promotion requires boundary competence.
rubric.control: Include a plain-communication or no-marker comparison task.

consent_policy: Obtain consent for recordings and private stories; permit written, typed, captioned and asynchronous responses.
